tools.name: list_blog_posts
tools.description: Lists The Wyze blog posts, newest first, with title, date, author, excerpt and URL. Optionally filter by a search term. Use get_blog_post with a slug for the full article.

tools.name: get_blog_post
tools.description: Returns one The Wyze blog post in full (plain text) by its slug.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_blog_posts, get_blog_post · Public sink: get_blog_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_blog_posts, get_blog_post · Public sink: get_blog_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
